card.name: Subjects that persist or endure
card.fires_on: Words that end a noun phrase about a habit, tradition, influence or memory, right before a verb about lasting or persisting (has continued, will last, is preserved). Often a linking word like which, that, has or will.

modes.label: Linking word before 'continued/last'
modes.description: A relative pronoun or auxiliary verb that leads into a verb meaning something lasts over time.
modes.example: initiated a habit of observation which<< has>> continued through all my life.

modes.label: End of an abstract noun
modes.description: The final piece of an -ism, -ship, -itions or tendency noun that is about to be said to persist or be present.
modes.example: The inwardness and moral ruggedness of Puritan<<ism>> she inherited mainly through her father, Edward

card.writes: It pushes the model toward verbs of staying or sticking, such as stuck, stayed and stay.
card.plain: It marks a spot where the text is about to say that a habit, memory or influence lasts or stays.
